name: happy
description: Recorded live against api.elfa.ai on 2026-10-30 with deno task record (trimmed and scrubbed). The key's plan is not charged the 1-credit base, and v3 billing starts on 1 November 2026, so x-elfa-credits reads 0 on v3 and on the 1-credit v2 endpoints (the zero claim is pruned and the published card settles) and 4 on the 5-credit v2 endpoints (the claim settles, the card rides out as mismatch.derived).

data.summary: ETF flow posts highlighted a divergence: U.S. spot XRP ETFs recorded $8.43M in net inflows on October 29 while Ethereum ETFs saw $105.48M in outflows and Solana ETFs lost $27.69M. Issuer-level Solana ETF updates showed Bitwise BSOL at -$23.7M and Grayscale GSOL at -$4M, alongside zero-flow updates from several other issuers.

Posts noted that spot Bitcoin ETF net inflows continued over multiple days—e.g., +$137.33M on October 28 and about $423.6M across October 26–28—while BTC traded near or below $80K, framing ETF demand as positive even as price sentiment remained bearish.
